Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd

Class CommandsManager

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.CommandsManager
public class CommandsManager extends Object
CommandsManager is responsible for creating and storing available command instances and providing lookup utilities for retrieving commands by their aliases.

It also manages a single global reference to the currently running SemiStatefulCommand (if any). This class mixes two responsibilities: - holding the registry of available commands (instance field commandsAliasMap) - tracking the currently active stateful command (static currentStatefulCommand).

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Field Details

    • currentStatefulCommand

      public static SemiStatefulCommand currentStatefulCommand
      The currently active stateful command, if any.

      Only one StatefulCommand can be active globally at a time. This field is static so that any part of the codebase can check or clear the current command via the static helper methods in this class.

      Possible values: - null: no stateful command is currently running - non-null: reference to the active StatefulCommand

    • commandsAliasMap

      public HashMap<String,Command> commandsAliasMap
      Registry of available commands mapped by their alias strings.

      Key: a single alias string (case-sensitive) that can be used to look up a command. Value: the Command instance associated with that alias.

      The map is populated in the constructor: each concrete command's aliasStream() is iterated and each alias is registered pointing to the same command instance. This allows fast O(1) alias lookups via getCommand(String).
